data.title: 因幡巡 · 存档点旁的膝枕浅眠
data.description: 通宵双人通关游戏后，晨光悄悄漫入客厅。手柄被随手搁在绒毯上，困极了的巡揉着眼角，毫不客气地把头枕在恋人的膝盖上。微卷的粉发散落在深色长裤上，嘴角还挂着通关后的得意呢喃，随后便发出均匀安心的浅浅鼻息。
data.action: resting head on lap, sleeping, holding hand, peaceful smile
data.lighting: soft early morning sunlight spilling across floor
data.promptProse: Resting her head comfortably on the viewer's lap after an all-night gaming session, Inaba Meguru falls asleep on the living room rug. Soft morning sunlight illuminates her messy pink hair and cozy loungewear as she holds the viewer's fingers peacefully.
data.animaCaption: Meguru sleeping sweetly with her head on a lap in the warm morning sun.
